author: IGN
description: Take a look at the PS VR2 Launch Trailer for The Boys: Trigger Warning, a VR story-driven adventure game developed by Arvore. Players will step into the outlandish world of The Boys in VR with devastating powers, corrupt superheroes, and plenty of hilarity to partake in. Enjoy PS VR2-specific features with eye-tracking support, enhanced visual fidelity, dynamic lighting, smooth high-refresh-rate gameplay, and PlayStation 5 Pro enhancements. The Boys: Trigger Warning is available now for PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2).
title: The Boys: Trigger Warning - Official PS VR2 Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Stupid Never Dies, an upcoming third-person action-adventure shooter developed by GPTrack50. Players will fight to bring their beloved back to life by venturing into dungeon after dungeon. Put powerful abilities to good use and take on the undead in Stupid Never Dies, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Stupid Never Dies - Official Gameplay Trailer

description:
Check out gameplay from Embers of the Uncrowned in this latest trailer for the upcoming dark fantasy MMORPG experience featuring fast-paced isometric combat with brutal, gory visuals. Embers of the Uncrowned will be available on PC. A demo will be available during Steam Next Fest from June 15 to June 22 PDT.

#ign #gaming
title: Embers of the Uncrowned - Official Demo Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Slayblade, a battle-top action roguelite game developed by Henry's House and Oscar Brittain. Players will collect parts, merge abilities, and take on opponents in battle-top engagements to acquire upgrades. Make cold hard cash and win the city in Slayblade, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Slayblade - Official Reveal Trailer

Edward and Caroline share a slightly awkward moment over a mug of hot chocolate in this cutscene from Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, the upcoming remake of the fan-favorite pirate-themed entry in the long-running Assassin's Creed series. Black Flag Resynced will be available on July 9 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced: Edward and Caroline Cutscene | IGN First

author: IGN
description: Watch the 'So Far, Together' Trailer for Destiny 2, the hit first-person action MMO developed by Bungie. Players can reminisce about the adventures, trials, victories, and everything in between experienced by players across the Destiny franchise. From the Witch Queen to the Taken King, Guardians will continue to make their own fate. Per Audacia Ad Astra, Destiny 2 is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
title: Destiny 2 - Official 'So Far, Together' Trailer

author: IGN
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Overview Trailer for The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu, a four-player co-op horror first-person shooter developed by ACE Team. Players will enter the depths of a South American cursed jungle with a team to take on all manner of enemies, secure riches, and maintain their sanity as madness creeps in. Survive the Lovecraftian threats in The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu, launching on July 15 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: IGN
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Teaser Trailer for Lords of the Fallen 2, a third-person dark fantasy melee-based action RPG developed by CI Games. Players can get a gritty look at the game's soulslike combat as a world buckles between life and death. Fight through the realm of the dead in Lords of the Fallen 2, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Lords of the Fallen 2 - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Final Fantasy Resonance was just revealed and we got play it during a visit to Square Enix. It’s the first HD-2D Final Fantasy game and brings the series back to turn-based combat while adapting the story of Brave Exvius for a traditional console-style RPG. Here we have gameplay of two boss fights - the first is against a main story boss early in the story and the second one is an optional fight against Ramuh who can be summoned into battle after you defeat him.
 
Final Fantasy Resonance comes out on October 22 for all major platforms including Switch 1 and 2, and you can check out what editor Michael Higham thinks of the game from his exclusive hands-on preview right here - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cet1Opcq0AA
title: Final Fantasy Resonance - Exclusive Boss Fight Gameplay

The trailer also showcases features and what you can expect, including a look at the Celebratory Special Mode. Stern Pinball's Transformers: More Than Meets the Eye pinball machine is available now.
title: Stern Pinball's Transformers: More Than Meets the Eye - Official Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out this trailer for The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival, an all new side-scrolling beat-em-up from Trailmark Games! Control Rick Grimes, Michionne and Daryl Dixon as you play through a re-imagining of the All Out War arc from the comics and AMC TV Show! Engage in brutal melee and ranged combat as you battle against hordes of walkers and pockets of Negan's faithful saviors! 

The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival is coming soon to PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and Xbox Series X|S.
title: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Evangelion Cosmetic Collaboration Trailer for The First Descendant, a free-to-play third-person looter shooter developed by Nexon Games. Players will be able to gain access to new cosmetics based on Evangelion, with the Asuka Plugsuit Skin, Rei Plugsuit Skin, and Mari Plugsuit Skin making their way to the game. The Evangelion Cosmetic Collaboration for The First Descendant is launching on June 18 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
